data.title: Wohngeld approval notice for Zeynep Musterkaya
data.summary: The Bezirksamt Beispiel-Spreeufer von Berlin (Wohngeldstelle) approved housing benefit (Wohngeld/Mietzuschuss) of €312.00 per month for Zeynep Musterkaya for the period 1 March 2025 to 28 February 2026. The office also asks for a landlord's rent certificate (Mietbescheinigung) showing the new rent since January 2025, to be sent by 24 April 2025.
data.explanation: This is a decision from your district housing office granting you monthly housing benefit (Wohngeld) of €312.00 for the period shown. Because your March 2025 rent was still calculated using your old tenancy agreement, you must send the office your landlord's rent certificate for the new rent since January 2025 by the stated date; otherwise your benefit may be recalculated under § 27 WoGG and any amount already paid too much reclaimed. If you believe the decision itself is wrong, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the district office; the app shows until when. A tenants' advice service or social welfare counselling office could help if anything is unclear.

remedy.addressee: Bezirksamt Beispiel-Spreeufer von Berlin, Uferstraße 40, 10551 Berlin
remedy.quote: Ist Ihrer Meinung nach etwas falsch entschieden worden, legen Sie bitte Widerspruch ein.

items.title: Submit landlord's rent certificate (Mietbescheinigung)
items.action: Send the housing office your landlord's rent certificate (Mietbescheinigung) showing the new rent since January 2025.
items.consequence: If it does not arrive in time, the housing benefit may be recalculated under § 27 WoGG and any amount already paid too much may be reclaimed.
items.quote: Bitte senden Sie uns bis zum 24.04.2025 die Mietbescheinigung Ihrer Vermieterin für die neue Miete ab Januar 2025 zu.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch)
items.action: If you believe the decision is wrong, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the district office, by letter or recorded in person.
items.quote: Erheben Sie ihn binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Bezirksamt Beispiel-Spreeufer von Berlin, Uferstraße 40, 10551 Berlin.

items.title: Receive monthly housing benefit (Wohngeld)
items.quote: bewilligen wir Ihnen für die Zeit vom 01.03.2025 bis 28.02.2026 Wohngeld in Höhe von 312,00 € monatlich.
